==Description==
The '''Mine''' was an unreleased tower that was only shown in a poll.

As it was never added to the game, its statistics are not known and likely were never made. However, its mechanics are known. Similarly to the [[Farm]], it would be an income generating tower and the second tower to be primarily focused on money generation. To differentiate itself from the [[Farm]], rather than generating income at the beginning of the wave, it would generate it over time.<ref name="poll">[[File:MineTowerPoll.png|280px]]</ref>

The '''Mine''' although polled, was never added. It lost to the [[Medic]], who had the highest number of votes and also the [[Slasher|Shredder]] who had the second highest vote count. While the other two ended up getting added, the '''Mine''' was not.<ref name="poll"/>
